title: ムテキなモーニングルーティン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, the martial arts Umamusume, starts her mornings bright and early at 5 a.m.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Master. Good morning, Adept. Good morning, family. I'm going to continue working hard today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She begins each day with a respectful greeting offered in the direction of her family's home, illuminated by the early morning sun.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Right, now for the next step of the routine… Time to begin recording.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Today, as part of my report, I'll be recording a glimpse into my daily life.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I begin by doing my laundry in the dorm washing machine. This way, it's all done by the time I've finished my morning routine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Although the dorm staff offer a comprehensive laundry service… I fear it's too convenient.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've learned the importance of learning how to be independent, so when I have the time, I wash my clothes by hand with a scrubbing board.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep… Splish, splash…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That said, on days when I need to focus on my running, I make use of the washing machine, like so. I'm counting on you, washing machine! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Next, I'll be introducing my pre-run nutritional intake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I use a dollop of miso paste to make miso soup. That said, all I am really doing is dissolving it in some hot water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwisssh… Clink, clink, clink.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My grandmother regularly sends me miso from the dojo. I've been having it in the mornings ever since I was young.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And it's ready.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hot! Hot, hot! …But it does hit the spot. I drink a cup every morning without fail to hydrate my body and replenish my minerals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Huff. I tend to run the same route every day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The reason for this is that if I run here at around this time—ah, here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrooooom…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The newspaper delivery scooter always comes down this road around now, and it makes for perfect racing competition.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I must bear road safety in mind when running… Hup!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Hehe, it appears the scooter's engine is running particularly well today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That said, just because I'm training doesn't mean I'll suffer defeat!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, in the commotion, I dropped my voice recorder, then stepped on it and smashed it to pieces…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was overly focused on my efforts to convey even a small fraction of my passion for running… My lack of discipline is entirely to blame.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Yaeno Muteki has broken the voice recorder she borrowed for a magazine feature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'll apologize to the magazine myself… but how can I help Yaeno Muteki who, after trying so hard to make a good impression, failed?
choice_data_list: Let's redouble our efforts to make up for the mishap!
Let's focus on writing everything down instead!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So you're suggesting that I unleash all my energy on the day of the upcoming interview, and seize that as an opportunity to discuss my routine once again?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Understood. Yes, you're right. It's no use crying over spilled milk… I must express my remorse through my actions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now that I have come to a decision, I believe I'll give my current morning routine some deeper consideration.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There's meaning in every aspect of it… During the interview, I must be ready to respond promptly and accurately to any questions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's resolve is reassuring. I'm pretty sure her interview's going to go great!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh… That's a brilliant idea!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is all for a magazine article, so it might be best to eliminate the need for any transcription.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! I'll create a complete log that meticulously details every area of my daily routine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And as there's no page limit, I'll write as much as I possibly can to compensate for my blunder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Yaeno Muteki sets out drafting an exhaustive report spanning hundreds of pages of detailed notes. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's only after she completes her report that I realize we could have just recorded her speaking using a phone in place of the voice recorder…
